company.name: Betterworks
company.shortDescription: Betterworks is an AI-powered performance management and talent intelligence platform for HR.
company.description: Betterworks is an AI-powered performance management and talent intelligence platform for HR. It is the pioneer in intelligent performance management software solutions. Its flexible, enterprise-ready SaaS platform helps workforces and organizations achieve their highest potential with tools that foster greater manager effectiveness and employee performance, leading to higher engagement and retention and, ultimately, better business outcomes. The Betterworks solution combines generative AI and data analytics that enable organizations to make smart, data-informed decisions linked to performance, calibration, skill development, career development, and succession planning. As a comprehensive, purpose-built performance management solution, it incorporates goal-setting, manager-employee conversations, feedback, employee engagement, and recognition — all accessible in the applications employees use daily in the flow of work, like email, calendars, and messaging apps. Betterworks’ modules capture structured and unstructured data to provide HR with both comprehensive and granular views of employee performance. This enables managers to easily coach employees in both performance and career development, continuously improving performance and elevating the employee experience.

aiResearchSummary.text: Betterworks is focused on developing techniques for performance summarization over time, which involve an enterprise system that collects and analyzes performance evaluations at different intervals. This system aims to enhance performance management by providing comprehensive insights into employee progress and goal achievement. These efforts align with Betterworks' mission to offer performance management and goal-setting solutions tailored for global enterprises.
